fields.title: 📖 Muḥākamah: The decision belongs to Allah and His Messenger ﷺ
fields.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Kathīr** said:

> ***“Ibn Kathīr explained that, after the judgment of Allah and His Messenger ﷺ, no believer still has a choice of his own against that judgment.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The Dīn is submission. When the judgment of revelation is clear, the heart’s choice against Allah and His Messenger ﷺ comes to an end.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn Kathīr, Tafsīr al-Qurʾān al-ʿAẓīm, Tafsīr zu Sūrah al-Aḥzāb 33:36.
